question: Gangaur Festival, Pushkar Fair, Nagaur Fair and Urs Fair are the popular fairs and festivals of which state?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Rajasthan**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Rajasthan is renowned for its vibrant cultural heritage and hosts numerous traditional fairs and festivals.
 
• The Gangaur Festival is celebrated primarily by women to honor the goddess Gauri, the consort of Lord Shiva, and is marked by elaborate processions and rituals.
 
• Pushkar Fair, also known as the Pushkar Camel Fair, is one of the largest camel and livestock fairs in the world and attracts thousands of tourists.
 
• The Urs Fair, held at Ajmer, commemorates the death anniversary of the Sufi saint Moinuddin Chishti and is a significant event for followers of Sufism and Islam.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Gangaur Festival**

 
 
• This festival is particularly significant in the state of Rajasthan and parts of Gujarat and Madhya Pradesh.
 
• It is dedicated to Gauri, a manifestation of Goddess Parvati, celebrating marital fidelity and conjugal happiness.
 
• Women dress in their finest clothes and jewelry, sing traditional songs, and take part in processions carrying beautifully decorated idols of Gauri.
 
 
 
• **Pushkar Fair**
 
 
• The Pushkar Fair is an annual multi-day livestock fair held in the town of Pushkar, Rajasthan.
 
• It is one of India's largest camel, horse, and cattle fairs, combined with various other events and competitions, such as the "matka phod," "longest mustache," and "bridal competition."
 
• The fair also includes cultural performances, folk dances, and music, making it a major tourist attraction.
 
 
 
• **Nagaur Fair**
 
 
• The Nagaur Fair, also known as the Ramdeoji Cattle Fair, is held annually in the town of Nagaur, Rajasthan.
 
• It is the second-largest cattle fair in India, where animals like camels, cows, bullocks, and horses are traded.
 
• The fair is also famous for its traditional folk music, dance performances, and various local sports and activities.
 
 
 
• **Urs Fair**
 
 
• The Urs Fair is held annually at the Dargah of Khwaja Moinuddin Chishti in Ajmer, Rajasthan.
 
• This event marks the death anniversary of the saint, which is celebrated with great fervor by his followers.
 
• Devotees from across the globe visit the shrine to seek blessings and participate in the Sufi music and devotional ceremonies.
